I just want to make sure the shipping address is changed to my home in Charlotte, and I’d like to update the desk lamp to black and the backpack to medium size and polyester material. If there are multiple color options for the backpack, I’d prefer grey.

Thanks for confirming all the details! Yes, the new address in Charlotte is correct, and those are the changes I’d like to make. For the payment method, let’s use a gift card for any price difference. Please go ahead and proceed.

Please update the backpack to the medium size, polyester, grey option you mentioned, and ship everything to my Charlotte address. Let me know if you need anything else from me!
Yes, that’s all correct! Please go ahead and make those changes. Thank you for your help.

That’s perfect, thank you so much for your help! I appreciate it. Have a great day!
